summary.text: Jim Simpson is the Republican candidate for Maryland State Senate District 11 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Shelly Hettleman (D).
An economist, businessman, author and journalist, he ran for the Maryland House of Delegates in District 11B in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Simpson was born in New Haven, Connecticut.

According to Ballotpedia, he earned an undergraduate degree in June 1983 after studying at Keystone College and the University of Delaware, and a master's degree from the University of Delaware in June 1985.
His professional experience includes working as an economist, businessman, author and journalist.

In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, he said his first career job was with the White House Office of Management and Budget, where he served on the director's economics staff and later as a budget analyst, and that he has published five books on national security, immigration, and economic and social issues.
Simpson was a Republican candidate for Maryland House of Delegates District 11B in 2022, finishing third with 16.8 percent of the vote in a race in which two seats were filled.
